issues.reason: Noun family sense is fine, but passive English only says specimens were photographed. Chinese adds 工作人员 as the photographer, an actor not specified by the saved English. Remove that addition or write an explicitly matched new pair.

Historical eliminative adjective is source-supported, but English's relative clause says the advertisement lacked supporting observations. Chinese 因为 asserts that this caused the historian's challenge, a causal link the sentence does not explicitly give. Keep both facts without adding a reason.

Plural noun limbless animals is supported, but several apods denotes a quantity of animals, not necessarily several kinds. Chinese 几种 adds taxonomic/category multiplicity. Use an individual quantity or explicitly match a revised English sentence.

Historical genus sense is supported, but English comparison is passive and does not identify who performed it. Chinese inserts 研究人员. Preserve an unspecified comparison or explicitly supply the same actor in a separately revised pair.

Noun protein component is correct, but kept measurements separate does not specify storage; Chinese 分开保存 asserts saving/storing the measurements. Translate separate treatment without a storage event, or match an explicitly revised English pair.

Noun cactus genus is fine, but moved away from the shelf does not specify an initial position beside it rather than on it. Chinese 从架子旁 adds that spatial relation. Preserve the noncommittal location in a revised sentence.

Noun drug name is source-supported, but English had lost the supplier's address gives no loss mechanism. Chinese 地址已经脱落 asserts physical detachment. Preserve missing address without specifying how it disappeared.

Plural noun oligonucleotide aptamers is supported, but two aptamers does not explicitly identify two kinds. Chinese 这两种 adds a type/category distinction; differing binding alone does not force it. Match the numerical referents without that added classification.
